source: Carl Bezold, Kebra Nagast: Die Herrlichkeit der Könige (Munich, 1905), ch. 28 — public domain. Geʿez text as in Ran HaCohen's Unicode edition of Bezold (tau.ac.il/~hacohen/KN, from Michal Jerabek's 1995 digitization), archived and checked against Bezold's printed page. Per-sign transliteration derived mechanically from Unicode; word-level romanization auto-generated (schwa-reduced) and approximate. Transliteration convention: ś = ሠ-series, ʿ = ዐ-series, ə = 6th order, 1st order ä, 4th order a. Translations made fresh from the Geʿez; Dillmann's Lexicon (1865) the lexical aid.
about: Solomon answers that God alone is to be worshipped, and that the Ark of the God of Israel was truly given to Israel, created before creation, with his commandments sent down in writing. The Queen vows to leave the sun and worship Israel's God, asks that the Ark be her lady, and thanks God for bringing her to hear the king. After six months she sends word that she wants to return home. Solomon, seeing her beauty, hopes for offspring, and the chapter defends his many wives by Genesis 22:17 and by the difference between the old law of the flesh and the Christian rule of one wife, as the apostles and Paul taught.

sentences.n: Chapter heading. ፳፰ is 20 + 8 = 28. በእንተ 'concerning' takes a construct; here it governs the clause ዘከመ 'how, in the way that' (ዘ- relative + ከመ 'as'). አዘዛ is አዘዘ 'he commanded' (root ʾ-z-z; the initial አ belongs to the root, as in ትእዛዝ 'commandment', and is not a causative prefix); the final -ዛ is the last radical ዘ plus the suffix -ኣ 'her'. ለንግሥት is not the object marker: it restates the pronoun in apposition, 'her, the Queen', as in ይቤላ ለንግሥት in ch. 27 (ንግሥት is the title, not a name).

sentences.l: And-answered king and-he-said-to-her: In-truth right they-worship to-God, to-who he-made all; heaven and-earth; and-sea and-dry-land; sun and-moon; stars and-lights(?); trees and-stones; cattle and-birds; wild-beasts and-creeping-things(?); fish and-sea-monsters(?); ቢሐተ(?) and-ዐንጐጓተ(?); lightnings and-ፀዓዓተ(?); clouds and-thunder; good-ones and-evil-ones.
sentences.i: The king answered and said to her: "It is truly right to worship God, who made everything: heaven and earth; sea and dry land; sun and moon; stars and lights; trees and stones; cattle and birds; wild beasts and creeping things; fish and sea monsters; ቢሐተ [biḥätä] (?) and ዐንጐጓተ [ʿängʷägʷatä] (?); lightning and ፀዓዓተ [ṣ́äʿaʿatä] (?); clouds and thunder; the good and the evil."
sentences.n: ወ- 'and' on the verbs ዓውሥአ (አውሥአ, causative: 'he answered') and ይቤላ (ይቤ 'he said' + -ላ 'to her'). ርቱዕ 'right, fitting' is a predicate adjective, with ይሰግዱ a subjunctive 'that they worship'. ሰገደ 'bow, worship' takes ለ-; ለዘ ገብረ ኵሎ = 'to the one who made all', ዘ- being the relative. The long list is in the accusative (nouns ending in -ä, as in ሰማየ, ምድረ, ወርኀ, and plurals in -ት (accusative -ተ) such as ከዋክብተ, ደመናተ), all objects of ገብረ 'made'; each pair is joined by ወ-. The list recalls Genesis 1 and Psalm 148 (creatures, sun and moon, stars, lightning, clouds). Uncertain: ቢሐተ, ዐንጐጓተ and ፀዓዓተ are not known to me with confidence (without Dillmann), and ጸዳላት 'lights' and ሐርገጽ 'creeping thing' are likely but unchecked; ዐናብርተ is from ዐንበር 'whale, large sea creature'. ሠናያነ ወእኩያነ is an accusative plural of persons or things, 'good ones and bad ones'.

sentences.l: To-him to-his-alone we-worship (it-is) fitting, in-fear and-in-trembling, in-joy and-in-gladness; for he lord-of all, creator-of angels and-man, and-he he-kills and-he-gives-life, and-he he-scourges and-he-has-mercy, he-who he-raises-him to-poor from-earth and-he-lifts-him from-ground to-needy, and-he-makes-grieve and-he-makes-glad, he-raises and-he-brings-down; there-is-not who he-restrains-him(?) for lord he of-all, and-there-is-not who he-says-to-him: what you-have-done;
sentences.i: It is right that we worship him alone, with fear and trembling, with joy and gladness; for he is Lord of all and the maker of angels and of people. He kills and he gives life; he scourges and he shows mercy. He raises the poor from the earth and lifts the needy from the ground; he saddens and he gladdens, he raises up and brings down. There is no one who can restrain him (?), for he is Lord of all, and there is no one who says to him, "What have you done?"
sentences.n: ሎቱ ለባሕቲቱ 'to him, to his aloneness' = 'to him alone' (ባሕቲት 'aloneness' with suffix). ንስግድ is a 1st-person plural subjunctive ('let us / that we worship') with ይደሉ 'it is fitting'. በ- is 'in, with' (manner: 'in fear'). ፈጣሬ መላእክት 'creator-of angels' is a construct chain. The paired verbs ይቀትል / ወያሐዩ ('kills / gives life', ያሐዩ causative of ሐይወ 'live') echo Deuteronomy 32:39 and 1 Samuel 2:6-8; 'raises the poor from the dust' is 1 Samuel 2:8 and Psalm 113:7. ዘያነሥኦ is a relative ዘ + imperfect with the object suffix -ኦ 'him', resumed by ለነዳይ 'the poor' (a pleonastic pattern). ዓልቦ 'there is not' (cf. አልቦ). እምድር is እም 'from' + ምድር 'earth' with the ም written once (cf. እመሬት 'from the ground'); the Hebrew of 1 Samuel 2:8 says 'dust', this text does not. ይግእዞ is uncertain: from a verb I take to mean 'restrain, hold back' (?), the same crux as አግአዞ in ch. 27 (rendered 'restrained (?)' there). ምንተ ገበርከ 'what have you done' echoes Job 9:12 and Daniel 4:35.

sentences.i: As for what you say, that he gave you the Ark of the law: truly, it was given to us, the Ark of the God of Israel, which was created before all creation by the counsel of his glory. And his commandments too he sent down to us in writing, so that we might know his justice and his judgment, which he established on the mountain of his sanctuary.
sentences.n: ወበእንተ ዘትብሊሰ: በእንተ 'concerning' + ዘ 'what' + ትብሊ 'you (fem.) say' (the Queen is addressed) + the contrastive -ሰ ('as for'). ወሀበክሙ 'he gave you' is her quoted claim (-ክሙ is 'you', plural). ታቦተ ሕግ 'ark-of law' is a construct (the form ታቦተ serves for both construct and accusative); ታቦተ አምላከ እስራኤል is another construct chain. ተውህበት is a passive (ተ- stem, 'was given'); ተፈጥረት 'was created' likewise, with feminine -ት agreeing with ታቦት, which is grammatically feminine (እንተ 'which', feminine). This is the book's Ark theology: the Ark is a pre-existent heavenly object, created before creation by God's counsel, not a human artifact; cf. Proverbs 8:22-23 on pre-existent wisdom. ወትእዛዞሂ 'and his commandments too' (ትእዛዝ + -ኦ 'his' + -ሂ 'too, indeed'); አውረደ 'he brought down' (causative of ወረደ 'descend'), ጽሒፎ is the gerund 'having written' (ጸሐፈ; CəCiCo like ርእዮ in ch. 27, subject God), so 'sent them down, having written them', and recalls the written tablets (Exodus 31:18). ደብረ መቅደሱ 'mount-of his-sanctuary' recalls Psalm 78:54 and Exodus 15:17. The ፨ ends the sense-unit.

sentences.i: The Queen said: "From now on I will not worship the sun, but I will worship the maker of the sun, the God of Israel. And may she, the Ark of the God of Israel, be my lady, for me and for my descendants after me and for all my kingdom, those under my rule."
sentences.n: ወትቤ 'and she said' (ትቤ from the irregular verb ትቤ/ይቤ 'say'). እምይእዜሰ 'from now indeed' (እም 'from', ይእዜ 'now', -ሰ emphatic). Note: ኢይሰግድ is formally 3rd-person ('he/one does not worship'), not 'I'; it may be a slip or impersonal, but the sense is clearly the Queen's own vow, matching እሰግድ 'I worship' in the same sentence (?). ፈጣሬ ፀሐይ 'maker-of sun' is a construct. ትኩነኒ is the subjunctive/jussive 'may she be to me' (3rd fem. ትኩን + suffix -ኒ 'to me'); እግዝእትየ 'my lady' (the Ark is addressed as ruler, a theological move: she places her kingdom under the Ark). ለዘርእየ 'to my seed'; ለ- repeats before each beneficiary; እለ እምታሕቴየ 'those from under me'.

sentences.i: For this reason I have found favor (?) in your sight and before the God of Israel, my maker, who brought me to you and let me hear your word and showed me your face and gave me understanding of your commandment.
sentences.n: ወበእንተዝ 'and for this reason' (በእንተ 'concerning' + ዝ 'this'). ኢነ ረከብኩ ሞገሰ is a crux: ኢነ is not a form I can parse. Read as a negative ('I have not found favor') it contradicts the four gifts that follow, and nothing marks a question, so I do not make it a question; it may be a corrupt printing of አነ 'I' (a guess), and I translate the clause as a plain statement 'I have found favor' (?), leaving ኢነ unrendered; ረከብኩ is 1st singular perfect, ሞገሰ accusative 'favor, grace' (cf. Genesis 18:3). በቅድሜከ 'in your presence' (ቅድም + ከ), በቅድመ is the construct form. ፈጣሪየ 'my maker'. The four causative (አ- stem) verbs with the object suffix -ኒ 'me' (አብጽሐኒ, አስምዐኒ, አርአየኒ, አለበወኒ) run in parallel: 'brought me, made me hear, showed me, made me understand'. 'See your face' recalls Genesis 33:10.

sentences.i: She settled (?) in a house, and continually she went and returned, and heard his wisdom and kept it in her heart. He also would go to her and tell her everything she had asked him, and she would go to him and question him, and he would let her know everything she wished.
sentences.n: አተወት is uncertain (?): I take it as 'she settled / made her home', with ቤተ 'house' in the accusative. The following imperfects (ተሐውር, ትገብእ, ትሰምዕ, ተዐቅብ) are habitual: 'she would go... return... hear... keep'. ጥበቢሁ is ጥበብ 'wisdom' (feminine) with the suffix -ሁ 'his' and the linking vowel -ኢ-, the same form as ስብሐቲሁ above; it is singular (the plural is ጥበባት). Keeping words in the heart echoes Luke 2:19. -ኒ after ውእቱ and ይእቲ is the 'also' particle. ተስእለቶ is read as a perfect 'she asked him' (the ተ- is unexplained (?)); ወትሴአሎ is an imperfect ('and she asks him'); ያየድዓ is a causative (አ- stem) verb 'make known': 'he makes her know' (?); the root is not identified here. ኵሎ ዘ- 'everything that'.

sentences.i: "As for me, if I wished I would stay with you (?), but now, for the sake of all the people, I want to return to my country. May God make what I have heard bear fruit in my heart and in the hearts of all who heard with me; for the ear is not filled with hearing, nor the eye with seeing your wisdom."
sentences.n: ወአንሰአ እምፈተውኩ እንበር is hard (?): አንሰ 'as for me' (አነ + -ሰ) with a stray አ; እምፈተውኩ is እም- + ፈተውኩ 'I wished' (the form is glossed 'if I wished' elsewhere), so I read it as 'as for me, if I wished I would stay (with you)'; 'as I wished' is the other possibility. ይእዘሰ 'but now' (ይእዜ + -ሰ). በእንተ ኵሉ ሕዝብ 'for the sake of all the people'. ይረስዮ is a jussive 'may he make it' (ረሰየ 'make, set') with ዘይፈሪ 'one that bears fruit' (ፈረየ 'bear fruit'); cf. the seed parable, Matthew 13:23. ልበ ኵሎሙ is construct ('heart-of all-of-them'). The last clause echoes Ecclesiastes 1:8 ('the eye is not satisfied with seeing, nor the ear filled with hearing'); the verb ይመልእ is imperfect, here with passive sense ('is filled'), and አፅምኦ / ነጽሮ are verbal nouns 'hearing', 'seeing'.

sentences.i: And it was not she alone who came, but many came from cities and by ሓውርት [ḥawrət] (?), from near and from far, for no one was found like him in wisdom in those days.
sentences.n: ወአኮ 'and not' negates the nominal clause (ይእቲ ባሕቲታ 'she by herself'); አላ 'but'. ዘትመጽእ 'who comes' is a relative with a feminine imperfect. ብዙኃን 'many' (plural) takes ይመጽኡ 'they come'. ወበሓውርት is uncertain (?): perhaps 'and by the journeys / roads' or a place term; I leave it. ከማሁ 'like him' (ከማ + ሁ). 1 Kings 4:34 and 10:1 (all peoples and kings came to hear Solomon's wisdom) lie behind this. በውእቱ መዋዕል 'in that days', መዋዕል being a plural form 'days, time'.

sentences.i: And it was not people alone who came to him: wild animals and birds also came to him, and heard his word, and marveled at his wisdom, and talked with him, and went back to their own lands. And everyone marveled at his wisdom, and marveled at what he had seen and heard.
sentences.n: ባሕቲቶሙ 'their aloneness' = 'by themselves' (ባሕቲት + -ሙ). ወዓዲ 'and still, also'. ዓራዊትኒ 'wild beasts, also' (-ኒ the 'even, also' particle). The verbs are third-person plural imperfects used narratively (ይመጽኡ, ይሰምዑ, ያነክሩ 'marvel at', from አንከረ, ይትናገሩ 'converse', a reciprocal ተ- stem, ይገብኡ 'return'). Beasts and birds hearing Solomon recalls 1 Kings 4:33 (he spoke of beasts, birds, reptiles, fish) in the tradition that he understood animal speech (cf. Qur'an 27:16). ጥበቦ and ጥበቢሁ are 'his wisdom' written with different suffix forms. The sense-unit ends at ፨.

sentences.i: When she sent word to him that she would return to her country, he thought in his heart and said: "Such a beautiful woman has come to me from the ends of the earth. Who knows whether God may give me offspring by her?"
sentences.n: ወሶበ 'and when'. ከመ ትሖር 'that she go' (a subjunctive; ሖረ 'go'). ብሔራ 'her land' (ብሔር + -ኣ '3fs her'). ኀለየ 'he thought, pondered'. ዘመጠነዝ ('of such a size') + ላሕይት 'beautiful' (feminine adjective). እምአጽናፈ ምድር 'from the ends-of earth' is a construct; cf. 'queen of the south... came from the ends of the earth', Matthew 12:42. ምንተ ኣአምር 'what do I know?' is a rhetorical 'who knows?'; እመ ይሁበኒ 'if he may give me' (እመ 'if, whether'), ዘርአ 'seed' = offspring (Genesis 15:3).

sentences.l: As it-is-said in book-of kings; and-Solomon-indeed king lover-of women he, and-he-married from Hebrews and-Egyptians and-Canaanites and-Edomites and-ኢዮባዊያን(?); and-from ሪፍ(?) and-ኰርጐ(?) and-Damascus and-ሱርስት(?); and-from those they-told-him, who good their-beauty;
sentences.i: As is said in the Book of Kings: Solomon was a king who loved women, and he married women from among the Hebrews, Egyptians, Canaanites, Edomites and ኢዮባዊያን [ʾiyobawiyan] (?); and from ሪፍ [rif] (?), ኰርጐ [kʷärgʷä] (?), Damascus and ሱርስት [sursət] (?); and from those of whom they told him, whose beauty was fine.
sentences.n: በከመ ተብህለ 'as it was said' (ተብህለ passive, ተ- stem of ይቤ 'say'). መጽሐፈ ነገሥት 'book-of kings' is a construct (1 Kings 11:1-8 lists Solomon's foreign wives). ሰሎሞንሰ has the contrastive -ሰ. መፍቀሬ አንስት 'lover-of women' (መፍቀሬ is an agent noun, construct; አንስት 'women', plural). አውሰበ 'he married' (a causative of 'take as wife'), እምነ ... 'from among ...'. The peoples end in -ዊያን, the plural of the adjective -ዊ 'of' (ዕብራዊ Hebrew, ግብጻዊ Egyptian, ከነናዊ Canaanite, ኢዶማዊ Edomite). 1 Kings 11:1 gives Moabites, Ammonites, Edomites, Sidonians, Hittites; ኢዮባዊያን may be a corrupt or different ethnic name (?). Uncertain: ሪፍ, ኰርጐ and ሱርስት are unclear to me as places or peoples (?); ድሚሲቅ is Damascus. ነገርዎ 'they told him'; ላሕዮን 'their (fem.) beauty' (ላሕይ + -ሆን '3fp their', contracted to -ዮን).

sentences.l: And-they-were queens 400 and-concubines 600; and-this-indeed what he-did, not by-fornication but by-thought-of wisdom which he-gave-him God, and-remembering what he-said to-Abraham: I-will-multiply your-seed like star-of heaven and-like sand-of sea.
sentences.i: He had four hundred queens and six hundred concubines. Yet what he did was not done through fornication but through the reasoning of the wisdom God gave him, and in remembering what God said to Abraham: "I will multiply your descendants like the stars of heaven and like the sand of the sea."
sentences.n: ወኮና: ኮና is the feminine plural of ኮነ 'be' ('they were', agreeing with ንግሥታት 'queens', fem. pl.). ፬፻ is 4 × 100 = 400, ፮፻ is 6 × 100 = 600, kept as written; 1 Kings 11:3 has 700 wives and 300 concubines, so this is the book's own tradition. ዘንተሰ ዘገብረ 'this indeed, that which he did'. አኮ 'not'; በዘምዎ 'by fornication' (ዘምዎ is the infinitive of ዘመወ, CəCwo like ነጽሮ; -ዎ is part of the infinitive, not a suffix); አላ 'but'; በኀልዮ ጥበብ 'by the thought-of wisdom' (construct). ተዘኪሮ 'remembering' (a gerund of ተዘከረ). The quotation is Genesis 22:17 (cf. 15:5, 32:12): ኣበዝኅ 'I will multiply' (1st sg. causative), with ከመ ኮከበ ሰማይ 'like the star-of heaven'. The book defends Solomon's marriages as a plan to multiply Abraham's seed.

glossary.ላሕዮን: ላሕይ — their beauty (noun + -ሆን '3fp their', contracted: ላሕዮን)
glossary.ልበ: ልብ — heart (construct 'heart of') · accusative 'the heart' (ያስተፈሥሕ ልበ 'it gladdens the heart')
glossary.ሎሙ: ለ — to them (preposition ለ- with 3mp suffix: ሎሙ)
glossary.ሎቱ: ለ — to him, for him (preposition ለ- with 3m sg suffix -tu: ሎቱ)
glossary.መፍቀሬ: መፍቀሪ — lover of (noun, construct, from ፈቀረ 'love')
glossary.ምስሌየ: ምስለ — with me (preposition, stem ምስሌ- + -የ '1cs me')
glossary.ምንተ: ምንት — what? (interrogative pronoun, accusative) · exclamatory 'how' (ምንተ ሠነየኒ ቃልከ 'how pleasing to me is your word')
glossary.ሠናያነ: ሠናይ — good ones (adjective, plural ሠናያን, accusative, used as a noun)
glossary.ርቱዕ: ርቱዕ — right, fitting (adjective, used as predicate)
glossary.ሰማየ: ሰማይ — heaven (noun, accusative of place 'in heaven') · accusative object 'heaven' (ገብረ ኵሎ ሰማየ ወምድረ 'he made heaven and earth')
glossary.ሰብሳብ: ሰብሳብ — unrecognized word (?) (in 'by the law of ___'; meaning unknown)
glossary.በሕገ: ሕግ — by the law of (በ- + noun, construct)
glossary.በምክረ: ምክር — by the counsel of (በ- + construct)
glossary.በቅድሜከ: ቅድም — in your presence, before you (በ- + ቅድሜ- + -ከ '2ms your')
glossary.በበ: በበ — each, every, by (distributive, doubled preposition በ-)
glossary.በኀልዮ: ኀልዮ — by thought, reasoning (በ- + verbal noun ኀልዮ of ኀለየ 'think', construct before ጥበብ)
glossary.በነጽሮ: ነጸረ — by seeing (በ- + verbal noun ነጽሮ of ነጸረ 'look')
glossary.በአሐቲ: አሐዱ — with one (በ- + fem. numeral አሐቲ)
glossary.በአማን: አማን — truth; በአማን 'in truth, truly' (በ- + noun)
glossary.በአውስቦ: አውሰበ — in marrying (በ- + verbal noun አውስቦ of አውሰበ)
glossary.በአፅምኦ: አጽምዐ — by hearing, listening (በ- + verbal noun አጽምኦ of the causative አጽምዐ, written here with አ-series ኦ)
glossary.በእንተ: በእንተ — concerning, about (+ construct) · for the sake of, on account of (በእንተ ፍሥሓ አዳም 'for the joy of Adam')
glossary.በከመ: ከመ — according as, just as (በ- + ከመ, conjunction)
glossary.በውእቱ: ውእቱ — in that (በ- + demonstrative, before መዋዕል 'days')
glossary.በዘ: ዘ — in that which, by that which (በ- + relative ዘ-; 'because, in that') · at that which, because of what (ሰምዐት በዘ ነገራ 'she heard at what he told her') · whereby, with which, purpose clause (በዘ ይኴንን ሕዝቦ 'that with which he may rule his people')
glossary.በዘምዎ: ዘመወ — through fornication, lust (በ- + verbal noun ዘምዎ of ዘመወ 'fornicate')
glossary.ቢሐተ: ቢሐተ — unrecognized word in the list of created things (?) (the ending looks like the accusative plural -ተ; meaning unknown)
glossary.ቤተ: ቤት — house of (noun, construct) · accusative 'a house' (አተወት ቤተ 'she settled in a house') · ቤተ ክርስቲያን 'church' (lit. 'house of Christians')
glossary.ብሔሮሙ: ብሔር — their country, lands (noun, accusative + -ሙ '3mp their')
glossary.ብእሲተ: ብእሲት — wife (noun; construct 'wife of') · accusative 'a woman, a wife' (አውሰበ አሐተ ብእሲተ 'he married one woman')
glossary.ብዙኀ: ብዙኅ — many, abundant (adjective, masc. sg.; written ብዙኀ, adverbial/predicate) · attributive after an accusative noun (ሞገሰ ብዙኀ 'abundant grace')
glossary.ብዙኃን: ብዙኅ — many (adjective, plural ብዙኃን, used as a noun)
glossary.ተባዕተ: ተባዕት — male (adjective/noun, accusative; ተባዕተ ውሉደ 'male sons')
glossary.ተብህለ: ብህለ — it is said (3ms perfect, tä-stem passive of ብህለ)
glossary.ተውህበት: ተውህበ — she was given (3fs perfect, passive of ወሀበ; subject ታቦት)
glossary.ተውህቦሙ: ተውህበ — it was given them (3ms perfect passive + -ሙ '3mp them')
glossary.ተጠቢቦ: ተጠበበ — being wise, acting wisely (gerund of ተጠበበ)
glossary.ተፈጥረት: ተፈጥረ — she was created (3fs perfect, passive of ፈጠረ; subject ታቦት)
glossary.ታቦተ: ታቦት — ark, tabernacle (construct 'ark of') · also accusative 'an ark' (ግበር ታቦተ 'make an ark')
glossary.ትሖር: ሖረ — that she go (3fs, after ከመ; the imperfect shape ትሖር)
glossary.ትብል: ብህለ — she says (3fs imperfect, after እንዘ 'saying')
glossary.ትኩነኒ: ኮነ — may she be to me (3fs jussive ትኩን + -ኒ '1cs to me')
glossary.ኀለየ: ኀለየ — he thought, reflected (3ms perfect, ḫ-l-y)
glossary.ኀቤሁ: ኀበ — to him (preposition + -hu, ኀቤሁ) · also 'of him' after ሰአለ 'ask' (ሰአለ ኀቤሁ 'he asked of him')
glossary.ኀቤሃ: ኀበ — to her, toward her (preposition ኀበ + -ሃ '3fs')
glossary.ኀጢአተ: ኀጢአት — sin (construct 'sin of') · also accusative, object: ገብረ ኀጢአተ 'he does sin'
glossary.ነበረት: ነበረ — she stayed, remained (3fs perfect, n-b-r)
glossary.ነገርዎ: ነገረ — they told him (3mp perfect + -ዎ '3ms him')
glossary.ናእምር: አእመረ — we know, that we may know (1cp subjunctive, root ʿ-m-r)
glossary.ንስግድ: ሰገደ — we worship, let us worship (1cp subjunctive/imperfect, s-g-d)
glossary.አህጉረ: ሀገር — cities (noun; plural አህጉር, accusative form)
glossary.አልቦ: አልቦ — there is not, none (negative existential)
glossary.አሐተ: አሐዱ — one (numeral, fem. accusative; አሐተ ብእሲተ 'one woman')
glossary.አምላከ: አምላክ — God of (noun, construct) · also accusative 'a god' (ካልአ አምላከ 'another god')
glossary.አውረደ: አውረደ — he brought down (3ms perfect, causative of ወረደ)
glossary.አውራኀ: ወርኅ — months (plural አውራኅ, accusative of duration)
glossary.አውሰበ: አውሰበ — he married (3ms perfect, causative of ወሰበ)
glossary.አዘዛ: አዘዘ — he commanded her (3ms perfect, root ʾ-z-z, + -ኣ '3fs her'; ለንግሥት after it restates the object)
glossary.ኢተሠርዐ: ተሠርዐ — it was not laid down (ኢ- + 3ms perfect passive of ሠርዐ)
glossary.ኢተውህቦሙ: ተውህበ — it was not given them (ኢ- + 3ms perfect passive + -ሙ '3mp them')
glossary.ኢነ: ኢ — not (?) (unparsed form ኢነ; perhaps a corruption of አነ 'I'; sense uncertain, rendered as no negation)
glossary.ኢያብዝኁ: አብዝኀ — that they not multiply, take many (ኢ- + 3mp subjunctive, causative)
glossary.ኢይመልእ: መልአ — it is not filled (ኢ- + 3ms imperfect of መልአ 'be full, fill')
glossary.ኢይሰግድ: ሰገደ — I will not worship (?) (ኢ- + imperfect, s-g-d; the form is 3ms ይሰግድ, though the speaker is the Queen; the sense 'I' is inferred from her vow)
glossary.ኣበዝኅ: አብዝኀ — I will multiply (1cs imperfect, causative of በዝኀ; God's words, Genesis 22:17)
glossary.ኣአምር: አእመረ — I know (1cs imperfect, root ʿ-m-r; ምንተ ኣአምር 'who knows')
glossary.እለሰ: እለ — those, indeed (relative pronoun pl. + enclitic -ሰ)
glossary.እመሬት: መሬት — from the ground, dirt (እም- + noun)
glossary.እምቅሩብ: ቅሩብ — from near (እም- + adjective used as adverb)
glossary.እምታሕቴየ: ታሕት — under me, beneath me (እም- + ታሕቴ- + -የ '1cs me')
glossary.እምኀበ: ኀበ — from (እም- 'from' + ኀበ; 'from the side of')
glossary.እምነ: እምነ — from (preposition, እምነ before a noun) · from among (እምነ ኴሉ ነጋድያን 'from among all the merchants'; 'apart from' is also possible there) · than, in comparison (ጥበብ ትኄይስ እምነ ኴሉ 'wisdom is better than all')
glossary.እምአጽናፈ: ጽንፍ — from the ends of (እም- 'from' + plural አጽናፍ, construct)
glossary.እምይእዜሰ: ይእዜ — from now on, indeed (እም- + ይእዜ 'now' + enclitic -ሰ)
glossary.እምድር: ምድር — from the earth (እም- + ምድር, the doubled ም written once; the Hebrew of 1 Samuel 2:8 has 'dust', this text does not)
glossary.እምፈተውኩ: ፈተወ — if I wished (እም- 'if', though 'rather than' is possible, + 1cs perfect, G) (?)
glossary.እንበር: ነበረ — that I stay, dwell (1cs subjunctive, G, n-b-r)
glossary.እንዘ: እንዘ — while, whilst (conjunction) · concessive 'although' (እንዘ ለሊሁ በኴር 'although he himself was firstborn'; ch. 16)
glossary.እግዚአ: እግዚእ — lord (noun; accusative predicate in -a, after ኩን) · construct 'lord of' (እግዚአ ኵሉ 'Lord of all')
glossary.እፈቅድ: ፈቀደ — I desire, wish (1cs imperfect, G)
glossary.ከላእነ: ከላእነ — unrecognized word (?) (after እኅት 'sister'; perhaps a foreign or corrupt term; meaning unknown)
glossary.ኵሉ: ኵሉ — all, every, the whole of
glossary.ወሀበክሙ: ወሀበ — he gave you (3ms perfect + -ክሙ '2mp you')
glossary.ወለመሀይምናንሰ: መሀይምን — and to the believers, indeed (ወ- + ለ- + noun, plural መሀይምናን + enclitic -ሰ)
glossary.ወለሰሎሞንሰ: ሰሎሞን — and to Solomon, indeed (ወ- + ለ- + proper name + enclitic -ሰ)
glossary.ወለአከት: ለአከ — and she sent (ወ- + 3fs perfect, l-ʾ-k)
glossary.ወለእለ: እለ — and to those who (ወ- + ለ- + relative pronoun pl.)
glossary.ወለኵሉ: ኵሉ — and to all, for all (ወ- + ለ- + ኵሉ)
glossary.ወለዘርእየ: ዘርእ — and to my seed, descendants (ወ- + ለ- + noun + -የ '1cs my')
glossary.ወሎቱ: ለ — and to him (ወ- + ለ- with 3ms suffix: ሎቱ)
glossary.ወሐርገጻተ: ሐርገጽ — and creeping things (?) (ወ- + plural, accusative; lemma and sense inferred from the form and the list)
glossary.ወሕገ: ሕግ — and the law of (ወ- + noun, construct)
glossary.ወምድረ: ምድር — and earth (ወ- + noun, fem., accusative)
glossary.ወሠርዑ: ሠርዐ — and they laid down, established (ወ- + 3mp perfect)
glossary.ወሰሎሞንሰ: ሰሎሞን — and Solomon, indeed (ወ- + proper name + enclitic -ሰ 'as for')
glossary.ወሱርስት: ሱርስት — and ሱርስት (?) (ወ- + place name; unidentified)
glossary.ወበሐሤት: ሐሤት — and in gladness (ወ- + በ- + noun)
glossary.ወበሓውርት: ሓውርት — and by/in ሓውርት (?) (ወ- + በ- + noun, perhaps from ሖረ 'go', 'journeys' or 'regions'; sense uncertain)
glossary.ወበረዓድ: ረዓድ — and in trembling (ወ- + በ- + noun)
glossary.ወበቅድመ: ቅድመ — and before (ወ- + በ- + preposition, with a following construct)
glossary.ወበእንተ: በእንተ — and concerning, about (ወ- + preposition) · and on account of, because of (ወበእንተ እከዮሙ 'and because of their evil')
glossary.ወበእንተዝ: በእንተዝ — and on this account (ወ- + preposition + demonstrative)
glossary.ወተዐቅብ: ዐቀበ — and she keeps, guards (ወ- + 3fs imperfect, ʿ-ḳ-b)
glossary.ወተዘኪሮ: ተዘከረ — and remembering (ወ- + gerund ተዘኪሮ of ተዘከረ 'remember')
glossary.ወትሰምዕ: ሰምዐ — and she hears (ወ- + 3fs imperfect, s-m-ʿ)
glossary.ወትሴአሎ: ሰአለ — and she asks him (ወ- + 3fs imperfect + -ኦ '3ms him')
glossary.ወትቤ: ይቤ — and she said (ወ- + 3fs perfect ትቤ of defective ይቤ)
glossary.ወትእዛዞሂ: ትእዛዝ — and his commandments (ወ- + noun, accusative + -ኦ 'his' + enclitic -ሂ 'also, and'; collective)
glossary.ወትገብእ: ገብአ — and she returns (ወ- + 3fs imperfect, g-b-ʾ)
glossary.ወአለበወኒ: አለበወ — and he gave me understanding (ወ- + 3ms perfect, causative of ለበወ 'understand' + -ኒ '1cs me')
glossary.ወአርአየኒ: አርአየ — and he showed me (ወ- + 3ms perfect, causative of ርእየ + -ኒ '1cs me')
glossary.ወአስምዐኒ: አስምዐ — and he made me hear (ወ- + 3ms perfect, causative of ሰምዐ + -ኒ '1cs me')
glossary.ወአቡሆሙ: አብ — and their father (ወ- + noun, stem አቡ- + -ሆሙ '3mp their')
glossary.ወአተወት: አተወ — and she settled, took up residence (?) (ወ- + 3fs perfect; sense inferred from the context)
glossary.ወአንሰአ: አነ — and as for me (?) (ወ- + አነ 'I' + enclitic -ሰ; the final -አ is unexplained)
glossary.ወአእባነ: እብን — and stones (ወ- + plural አእባን, accusative)
glossary.ወአውሰበ: አውሰበ — and he married (ወ- + 3ms perfect, causative of ወሰበ; of a man taking a wife)
glossary.ወአዕዋፈ: ዖፍ — and birds (ወ- + plural አዕዋፍ, accusative)
glossary.ወኢኮኖ: ኮነ — and it was not for him (ወ- + ኢ- + 3ms perfect + -ኖ 'for him')
glossary.ወኢይመልእ: መልአ — and it is not filled (ወ- + ኢ- + 3ms imperfect)
glossary.ወኢዮባዊያን: ኢዮባዊ — and ኢዮባዊያን (?) (ወ- + plural of a people-name in -ዊ; people unidentified, perhaps Ammonites or Moabites)
glossary.ወኢዶማዊያን: ኢዶማዊ — and Edomites (ወ- + noun in -ዊ, plural ኢዶማዊያን)
glossary.ወእሙንቱሰ: እሙንቱ — and they, indeed (ወ- + 3mp pronoun + enclitic -ሰ)
glossary.ወእምሪፍ: ሪፍ — and from ሪፍ (?) (ወ- + እም- + place name; unidentified)
glossary.ወእምርሑቅ: ርሑቅ — and from far (ወ- + እም- + adjective used as adverb)
glossary.ወእምእለ: እለ — and from those who (ወ- + እም- + relative pronoun pl.)
glossary.ወእኩያነ: እኩይ — and evil ones (ወ- + adjective, plural እኩያን, accusative, used as a noun)
glossary.ወከመ: ከመ — and that (ወ- 'and' + conjunction) · and like, and as (ወ- + ከመ 'like, as' before a noun: ወከመ ፈውስ ለድዉይ 'and like healing to the sick')
glossary.ወከነናዊያን: ከነናዊ — and Canaanites (ወ- + noun in -ዊ, plural ከነናዊያን)
glossary.ወኮና: ኮነ — and they were, there were (ወ- + 3fp perfect, k-w-n)
glossary.ወኰርጐ: ኰርጐ — and ኰርጐ (?) (ወ- + place name; unidentified)
glossary.ወኵሉ: ኵሉ — and all, every (ወ- + noun, before a noun with suffix) · and everyone (ወኵሉ ያነክር 'and everyone marvels')
glossary.ወወርኀ: ወርኅ — and moon (ወ- + noun, accusative; also 'month')
glossary.ወወትረ: ወትር — and continually (ወ- + noun used adverbially, accusative)
glossary.ወውእቱኒ: ውእቱ — and he also (ወ- + pronoun + enclitic -ኒ)
glossary.ወዐናብርተ: ዐንበር — and sea monsters (?) (ወ- + plural ዐናብርት, accusative; sense inferred)
glossary.ወዐንጐጓተ: ዐንጐጓተ — and an unrecognized word (?) (ወ- + form ending in -ተ, probably the accusative plural; meaning unknown)
glossary.ወዓልቦ: አልቦ — and there is not, none (ወ- + ዓልቦ, written with ዓ-)
glossary.ወዓውሥአ: አውሥአ — and he answered (ወ- + 3ms perfect, causative, w-ś-ʾ; written with ዓ-)
glossary.ወዓዲ: ዓዲ — and still, also, moreover (ወ- + adverb)
glossary.ወዕቁባት: ዕቅብት — and concubines (ወ- + noun, plural ዕቁባት)
glossary.ወዘሰ: ዘ — and whoever, indeed (ወ- + relative ዘ + enclitic -ሰ)
glossary.ወዘንተ: ዝንቱ — and this (ወ- + accusative ዘንተ, demonstrative)
glossary.ወዘንተሰ: ዝንቱ — and this, indeed (ወ- + accusative ዘንተ + enclitic -ሰ)
glossary.ወየብሰ: የብስ — and dry land (ወ- + noun, accusative of place 'by land') · accusative object 'and dry land' (ወባሕረ ወየብሰ 'sea and dry land', as things made)
glossary.ወያሌዕሎ: አልዐለ — and he lifts him (ወ- + 3ms imperfect, causative of ልዕለ 'be high' + -ኦ 'him')
glossary.ወያሐዝን: አሐዘነ — and he saddens (ወ- + 3ms imperfect, causative of ሐዘነ 'grieve')
glossary.ወያሐዩ: አሐየወ — and he gives life (ወ- + 3ms imperfect, causative of ሐይወ 'live')
glossary.ወያስተፌሥሕ: አስተፈሥሐ — and he gladdens (ወ- + 3ms imperfect, causative-reflexive stem of ፈሥሐ 'rejoice')
glossary.ወያነክሩ: አነከረ — and they marvel (ወ- + 3mp imperfect, causative; takes accusative object)
glossary.ወያነክር: አነከረ — and he marvelled (ወ- + 3ms imperfect, causative, 'wonder, marvel'; narrative use)
glossary.ወያወርድ: አውረደ — and he brings down (ወ- + 3ms imperfect, causative of ወረደ)
glossary.ወያየድዓ: አየድዐ — and he lets her know (ወ- + 3ms imperfect, causative + -ኣ '3fs her')
glossary.ወይሠርውዎሙ: ሠርወ — and they will subdue them (?) (ወ- + 3mp imperfect + -ዎሙ '3mp them'; sense uncertain)
glossary.ወይሣሀል: ሣሀለ — and he has mercy (ወ- + 3ms imperfect)
glossary.ወይቤላ: ይቤ — and he said to her (ወ- + 3ms perfect of defective ይቤ + -ላ '3fs to her')
glossary.ወይትናገሩ: ተናገረ — and they converse, speak together (ወ- + 3mp imperfect, tä-stem of ነገረ)
glossary.ወይነግራ: ነገረ — and he tells her (ወ- + 3ms imperfect, G + -ኣ 'her')
glossary.ወይእቲኒ: ይእቲ — and she also (ወ- + 3fs pronoun + enclitic -ኒ)
glossary.ወይእዘሰ: ይእዜ — and now indeed (ወ- + ይእዜ 'now' + enclitic -ሰ; written ይእዘ-)
glossary.ወይጸርኁ: ጸርሐ — and they cry out (ወ- + 3mp imperfect)
glossary.ወደሞ: ደም — and his blood (ወ- + noun, accusative + -ኦ 'his')
glossary.ወግብጻዊያን: ግብጻዊ — and Egyptians (ወ- + noun in -ዊ, plural ግብጻዊያን)
glossary.ወጸዳላተ: ጸዳል — and lights, radiances (?) (ወ- + plural ጸዳላት, accusative; sense inferred)
glossary.ወፀዓዓተ: ፀዓዓተ — and an unrecognized word (?) (ወ- + form ending in -ተ, probably the accusative plural; meaning unknown, perhaps a natural phenomenon)
glossary.ውስተ: ውስተ — in, within, into · to, among (ወለአከ ውስተ ኵሉ ነጋድያን 'and he sent to all the merchants') · at (ውስተ መድረከ ኆኃቲሃ 'at the threshold of her doors')
glossary.ውእቱ: ውእቱ — he (3m sg independent pronoun) · also demonstrative 'that' before a noun (በውስተ ውእቱ ሥዕለ 'in that image') and copula 'it is' after a predicate (ጽድቅ ውእቱ 'true it is')
glossary.ዓልቦ: አልቦ — there is not, none (negative existential, written with ዓ-)
glossary.ዓራዊትኒ: አርዌ — wild beasts also (plural ዓራዊት + enclitic -ኒ 'also')
glossary.ዘመጠነዝ: መጠን — of such size, such a (ዘ- + መጠነ 'measure' + demonstrative -ዝ)
glossary.ዘሠርዐ: ሠርዐ — which he established, ordained (ዘ- relative + 3ms perfect, ś-r-ʿ)
glossary.ዘሥጋ: ሥጋ — of flesh (ዘ- + noun; 'the law of the flesh')
glossary.ዘርአ: ዘርእ — seed (construct 'seed of') · also 'seed' as sown grain, absolute (ዘርአ ወማእረረ 'seed(time) and harvest') · accusative 'offspring' (ይሁበኒ እግዚኣብሔር ዘርአ 'may God give me offspring')
glossary.ዘሰማዕኩ: ሰምዐ — what I heard (ዘ- relative + 1cs perfect, s-m-ʿ)
glossary.ዘበሰማያት: ሰማይ — which (is) in the heavens (ዘ- relative + በ- + plural ሰማያት)
glossary.ዘተመጠዉ: ተመጠወ — those who received (ዘ- relative + 3mp perfect, tä-stem)
glossary.ዘተረክበ: ተረክበ — who was found (ዘ- relative + 3ms perfect, passive of ረከበ)
glossary.ዘተስእለቶ: ሰአለ — what she asked him (?) (ዘ- relative + 3fs perfect + -ኦ '3ms him'; the ተ- prefix is unexplained)
glossary.ዘትብሊሰ: ብህለ — what you say, indeed (ዘ- relative + 2fs imperfect ትብሊ, the Queen addressed, + enclitic -ሰ 'as for, indeed')
glossary.ዘአብጽሐኒ: አብጽሐ — who brought me (ዘ- relative + 3ms perfect, causative of በጽሐ 'arrive' + -ኒ '1cs me')
glossary.ዘወሀቦ: ወሀበ — which he gave him (ዘ- relative + 3ms perfect + -ኦ 3ms object)
glossary.ዘያነሥኦ: አንሥአ — who raises him (ዘ- relative + 3ms imperfect, causative of ንሥአ 'rise' + -ኦ '3ms him')
glossary.ዘይቤሎ: ብህለ — what he said to him (ዘ- relative + 3ms perfect ይቤ + -ሎ 'to him')
glossary.ዘይብሎ: ብህለ — who says to him (ዘ- relative + 3ms imperfect ይብል + -ሎ 'to him', b-h-l)
glossary.ዘይግእዞ: ገእዘ — who restrains him (?) (ዘ- relative + 3ms imperfect + -ኦ 'him'; lemma, root and sense uncertain)
glossary.ዘይፈሪ: ፈረየ — who bears fruit (ዘ- relative + 3ms imperfect, f-r-y)
glossary.ዘገብረ: ገብረ — what he did (ዘ- relative + 3ms perfect, g-b-r)
glossary.ዘፈተወት: ፈተወ — what she wished, desired (ዘ- relative + 3fs perfect, f-t-w)
glossary.የሐውር: ሖረ — he walks, goes (3ms imperfect, ḥ-w-r)
glossary.ያመልኩ: አምለከ — they worship (3mp imperfect, causative, ʾ-m-l-k)
glossary.ያነክር: አነከረ — he marvels (at) (3ms imperfect, causative, with accusative object)
glossary.ያዐርግ: አዕረገ — he raises up (3ms imperfect, causative of ዐርገ 'ascend')
glossary.ይሁበኒ: ወሀበ — may he give me (3ms jussive ይሁብ + -ኒ '1cs me')
glossary.ይረሱ: ወረሰ — they will inherit (3mp imperfect/jussive, w-r-s)
glossary.ይረስዮ: ረሰየ — may he make it (3ms jussive + -ኦ 'it'; ረሰየ 'make, render')
glossary.ይቀሥፍ: ቀሠፈ — he scourges, strikes (3ms imperfect, ḳ-ś-f)
glossary.ይቤሉ: ብህለ — they said (3mp perfect ይቤሉ, b-h-l)
glossary.ይብሉ: ብህለ — they say (3mp subjunctive/imperfect, after እንዘ 'saying')
glossary.ይብል: ብህለ — he says (3ms imperfect, G stem, defective verb b-h-l)
glossary.ይንበሩ: ነበረ — that they live (3mp subjunctive, n-b-r)
glossary.ይደሉ: ደለወ — it is fitting, due (3m sg imperfect, d-l-w)
glossary.ገበርከ: ገብረ — you have done (2ms perfect, g-b-r)
glossary.ገቢዓ: ገብአ — returning, a return (verbal noun ገቢእ, accusative; written ገቢዓ)
glossary.ገብረ: ገብር — servant, slave (noun; accusative predicate in -a, after ኩን) · also the verb ገብረ: he did, made (3ms perfect, g-b-r; ገብረ ሠናየ 'he did good')
glossary.ጥበቢሁ: ጥበብ — his wisdom (noun, fem. + -ሁ '3ms his'; the suffix anticipates the possessor named with ለ-) · plain 'his wisdom' with no ለ- phrase following (ከመ ትስማዕ ጥበቢሁ 'that she may hear his wisdom')
glossary.ጥበቦ: ጥበብ — his wisdom (noun, fem., accusative + -ኦ '3ms his')
glossary.ጽሒፎ: ጸሐፈ — written, in writing (gerund ጽሒፎ, ṣ-ḥ-f; 'having written')
glossary.ፀር: ፀር — enemy (noun; genitive after the construct አህጉረ, 'of the enemy')
glossary.ፈቀደት: ፈቀደ — she wished, wanted (3fs perfect, f-ḳ-d)
glossary.ፍትሖ: ፍትሕ — his judgment (noun, accusative ፍትሐ + -ሁ '3ms his')
glossary.፩: ፩ — numeral 1 — chapter number · spoken አሐዱ (ʾäḥädu) 'one', in ch. 22 'a certain' (ወሀለወ ፩ ልብው 'there was a certain wise man') · 'one' of a number (ከመ ፩ እምአግብርቲከ 'as one of your servants')
glossary.፬፻: ፬፻ — 400, spoken አርባዕቱ ምእት (ʾärbaʿtu məʾət) 'four hundred' (numeral)
glossary.፮፻: ፮፻ — 600, spoken ስድስቱ ምእት (sədstu məʾət) 'six hundred' (numeral)
glossary.፳፰: ፳፰ — 28, spoken ዕሥራ ወሰመንቱ (ʿəśra wä-sämäntu) 'twenty-eight'; chapter number (numeral)
